shared_elements: procession/row of figures facing one direction
low-relief carving of figures with linear detail
registers or horizontal banding of content
justification: Both depict profile human figures arranged in a directional procession, with attendants presenting or carrying objects toward a larger/receiving figure, an offering-presentation scheme. However, A is a single large-scale frieze of tall, heavily detailed bearded figures with elaborate garments and staff, while B is a small stacked composition of multiple registers of squat schematic figures combined with dense script and a winged/eye symbol at the top, elements entirely absent from A.
